_about: Lore data (docs/lore/README.md; decisions 257, 258): entries with facts, each fact saying who knows it. Code uses only status agreed. Facts, never lines to say.

entries.name: deer
entries.summary: Deer graze in the wilds and flee together from what they see or hear.

facts.text: Deer graze in the wilds.
Deer flee together from what they see or hear.
A hunter takes meat and a hide from a deer.

entries.name: stag
entries.summary: A stag is a deer with antlers, and keeps with the deer.

facts.text: A stag is a deer with antlers.
A stag grazes and flees with the deer.
A hunter takes meat, a hide and antlers from a stag.

entries.name: rabbit
entries.summary: Rabbits graze in the wilds and flee together from what they see or hear.

facts.text: Rabbits graze in the wilds.
Rabbits flee together from what they see or hear.
A hunter takes meat and a hide from a rabbit.

entries.name: boar
entries.summary: A boar of the wilds flees, but charges when it is cornered.

facts.text: Boar live in the wilds.
A boar flees, but charges when it is cornered.
A hunter takes meat, a hide and tusks from a boar.

entries.name: wolf
entries.summary: Wolves hunt game in the wilds and are more dangerous at night.

facts.text: Wolves hunt deer and rabbits in the wilds.
Wolves are more dangerous at night.
A hunter takes a hide from a wolf.

entries.name: great bear
entries.summary: A bear far bigger than any other keeps a den and its ground in the forest, roams and hunts deer by day and sleeps in its den by night.

facts.text: In the forest lives a bear far bigger than any other.
The great bear keeps a den and the ground around it.
The great bear roams and hunts deer by day, and sleeps in its den by night.
A lone traveller does well to go round the great bear.

entries.name: wolfskin
entries.summary: A man of the town who swore himself to one of the old tribe's gods and put on a wolf's skin; by night he runs as a wolf at the forest's edge (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's lean (a)).

facts.text: By night the wolfskin runs as a wolf at the forest's edge.
Someone in town is gone at night, and nobody says who; some say he is the wolfskin.
The wolfskin swore himself to one of the old tribe's gods and put on a wolf's skin, and the oath won't let him take it off at night.
Silver, fire and a blessing from Theus's temple hold the wolfskin off.

entries.name: pale lord
entries.summary: The lord of the Old Tower, who was not among its fallen and has lived on blood since; by night he walks the ruins around the tower (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's lean (a)).

facts.text: At night the pale lord walks the ruins around the Old Tower.
No one walks the old road past the Old Tower after dark.
The pale lord was lord of the Old Tower when it was taken; he was not among the fallen buried in the barrow, and he has lived on blood ever since.
Running water, lamps and fire, the blessed ashes and the dawn hold the pale lord off.

entries.name: hollow stag
entries.summary: A great stag that grazed too near the mine and came back changed by the rot: silent, its eyes lit like the fallen star; not one of the dead (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's lean (a)).

facts.text: At night a great stag walks near the ruins, silent, its eyes lit.
The hollow stag grazed too near the mine and came back changed by the rot, as the Blood Rot are.

entries.name: troll
entries.summary: Trolls are one of the land's old peoples: huge and slow, living in hill caves, hurt by daylight (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's lean (a)).

facts.text: Trolls are one of the land's old peoples, huge and slow, and they live in hill caves.
Daylight hurts a troll, so it keeps to its cave by day.

entries.name: old wolf
entries.summary: An old grey wolf that a pack follows in the hills and foothills (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's name).

facts.text: In the hills and foothills a wolf pack follows an old grey.
A hunter from the forest's camps went up into the foothills after the old grey, and never came back.

entries.name: hill cat
entries.summary: A great cat that lies up in the hill rocks and drops on whatever passes (Jeff, 2026-11-03: lore's name).

facts.text: A great cat lies up in the hill rocks and drops on whatever passes.
The hill cat hunts from dusk to dawn and lies up by day.
The hill folk lose goats to the hill cat, and a herder looks up at the rocks before he walks under them.
The hill cat keeps away from roads and towns.

entries.name: boar king
entries.summary: The boar king lives in the boar's lair in the forest; left alone a while, he ventures out into the forest (Jeff, 2026-11-03: "Move the boar king to the boar's lair in the forest ... If he hasn't been killed in a while, he might decide to venture out into the forest").

facts.text: The boar king lives in the boar's lair in the forest.
Left alone a while, the boar king ventures out into the forest.
